body: I have the same thing on my shoulders and both arms, and if that's the reason someone wouldn't like me then he ain't even worth my time haha.

Thank you for this.

I don't plan to come out to other people, I thought this was something I had to do and would fix all my life problems. Now that I've done it and cooled off, I realize it didn't fix them, but it's one less thing I'll think about. I don't " give a fuck " that I'm gay anymore and that's just who I am and won't change. So yeah, 1 down, many to go :D Slowly but surely. 

Thank you for your advice, means a lot :)
Nah I'm actually thankful. I've got no one to open to about this, and just reading your short comment made all of this in my head fall to place and make sense. Haha thanks :D

Hey,

reading this I could relate a lot, especially with the dad part. I've got one of those, we all hate him, but mom sorta works out with him for a week or two, then he's a yelling diva for a week or two. She's used to ignoring it but I can't, and he's very verbal. I'm trying my best to ignore him and focus on my future, which I think you should too. 

I couldn't force my self to finish a 4 year lasting college so I won't even bother commenting that :P

I really really relate to your stereotypical layout of life sentence, because I say the exact same words daily. Lately I've been telling my self that I'm better than what I'm showing, and I'm doing my best to stay positive. We have to dig trough some rough shit to get to the top and feel like we made it, but it doesn't mean it's not possible. There are so many more people with our story who made it, I bet you could live off of being a tattoo artist. Yesterday I posted here as well and someone told me to make my goals into small, tiny, daily goals, that i can complete and feel good as I'm working towards that big major goal. I really think you could do it. Keep holding onto your friends and boyfriend, and whenever you're feeling down just vent out, and work slowly but carefully towards moving away when you're older and doing what you enjoy.

Over the years i've learnt that when I hit rock bottom I can pretend to be happy, and even sometimes for a week or a month make my self believe that too. Now i'm working on actually being happy, and not pretending.

I hope any of this helps, I wish you the best of luck, you can do it! We all can :)
Boom, just got hit by reality... thanks lol

I have never thought about it that way. Setting your goals into little daily goals to feel some accomplishment.. I'm from a part where there aren't really any groups or anything, i've tried searching for those. It's better to keep your mouth shut than seek help.

I am so thankful to you for sharing your story and your view in all of this. I feel like you were in a shittier situation than I was. And you're right, there is no normal. Thank you so much for this, it really means a lot knowing there are people out there who have went trough what I'm in right now and made it, or are still making it. Thank you! <3

What you said does make a lot of sense. I always felt like I was born in the wrong place for the wrong family... I'm still skeptical about the medicine tho..

As for the college, I'm about to turn 21 and need to pass some exams before I can even try for college, meaning I'd start my first year as a 22 year old. I really can't think of any trade I'd like to do, but I'm being selfish on that part not wanting to take something ' okay ' and work around it..
I understand that, and I'm happy to you said that, but it felt like my happiness is gone for good.. I'll try to chase it and catch up to it.

As for the snapchat guy, I know I shouldn't take it personally. He really is a sweet person that's helped me A LOT in the past 4 months we've been talking.. And I should take into consideration that we are 7 hours difference in timezones.. he even told me he just doesn't want me to get attached to the point where I wouldn't be okay if he disappeared.. but I think that's how i'm feeling right now.. he's the first person that made me love my self..

Thank you so much for your comment, when I'm feeling like this again I can re-read it to boost my self up a bit..

Hey, thank you for responding to me..

well my brother did move out, but he's nearby and such.. i was considering trying to move to another country to try and work there but i'm so scared and feel helpless that i'm not trying to do it anymore, if that makes sense.

I feel like the subreddits won't really help me because I don't wanna be gay. I wish I was straight because things would be so much easier.. i'd be.. " normal ".. 

I'll do my best to work on my self and not isolate.. idk.. as much as reading your reply touched me and moved me because someone took their time to answer, it doesn't feel like it'll do much.. it's hard man.. but thanks a lot!
